title: A coronavirus protease activates sensory neurons via TRPA1 to drive sneeze, cough, and pain
title_zh: 冠状病毒蛋白酶通过 TRPA1 激活感觉神经元以驱动打喷嚏、咳嗽和疼痛
abstract: Sneezing, coughing, and pain are common symptoms of respiratory viral infection. These responses are initiated by airway-innervating nociceptors that detect noxious stimuli, but how SARS-CoV-2 activates these neurons remains unclear. Here, we show that the coronavirus papain-like protease (PLpro) directly activates airway-innervating nociceptors in mice and human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived nociceptors. PLpro triggers sneezing, coughing, acute pain, and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) release in the airways. Both the proteolytic activity of PLpro and the host ion channel transient receptor potential ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) are required for neuronal activation and sneezing. Infection with the mouse-adapted SARS-CoV-2 or the murine coronavirus MHV-A59 also induces sneezing in mice, and MHV-A59-evoked sneezing is TRPA1-dependent. SARS-CoV-2 infection of the trigeminal ganglia altered transcriptional programs associated with nociception, including upregulation of the TRPA1-CGRP signaling pathway activated by PLpro. Together, these findings reveal a direct mechanism by which SARS-CoV-2 triggers pain and airway reflexes and identify PLpro and TRPA1 as potential therapeutic targets for COVID-19.
abstract_zh: 打喷嚏、咳嗽和疼痛是呼吸道病毒感染的常见症状。这些反应由支配气道的感受性神经元发起，用于检测有害刺激，但 SARS-CoV-2 如何激活这些神经元尚不明确。本文表明，冠状病毒木瓜样蛋白酶（PLpro）能直接激活小鼠和人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）衍生的感受性神经元。PLpro 引发打喷嚏、咳嗽、急性疼痛以及气道中降钙素相关基因肽（CGRP）的释放。PLpro 的蛋白酶活性和宿主离子通道瞬时受体电位变形蛋白 1（TRPA1）对于神经元激活和打喷嚏均为必需。小鼠适应型 SARS-CoV-2 或小鼠冠状病毒 MHV-A59 感染也会诱发小鼠打喷嚏，且 MHV-A59 诱发的打喷嚏依赖于 TRPA1。SARS-CoV-2 感染三叉神经节改变了与伤害感受相关的转录程序，包括上调由 PLpro 激活的 TRPA1-CGRP 信号通路。这些发现共同揭示了 SARS-CoV-2 触发疼痛和气道反射的直接机制，并确定 PLpro 和 TRPA1 作为 COVID-19 的潜在治疗靶点。
